memberships.page_title: Filtered Regular Nilpotent Pencils in Dimension Five

statement: For a global regular-type five-dimensional nilpotent quadratic tensor with full-span collision-line kernel, the saturated rank-one defects are nested and have total codimension-two class 20H^2, combined Hilbert polynomial 10n^2+50n+81, and weighted effective increments 5Delta_1+4Delta_2+3Delta_3+2Delta_4+Delta_5=20H^2.
